sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION If you invest in our common stock or pre-funded warrants in this offering, your ownership interest
will be diluted to the extent of the difference between the public offering price per share of our common stock or pre-funded warrants and the as-adjusted net tangible
book value per share of our common stock immediately after this offering. We calculate net tangible book value per share by dividing the net tangible book value (our tangible assets less our total liabilities) by the number of outstanding shares of
our common stock. The historical net tangible book value of our common stock as of September 30, 2023 was $395.5 million, or

sections.excerpt:
